============================================================
  DICOM VIEWER  —  PORTABLE STUDY DISC
  Not for diagnostic use.
============================================================

CONTENTS
--------
  dicom-viewer.exe       The viewer (Windows).
  dicom-viewer           The viewer (macOS / Linux), if shipped.
  DICOM\                 Imaging study data (.dcm files).
  autorun.inf            Windows AutoPlay manifest.
  HELP.txt               Keyboard shortcuts and tips.
  LICENSE.txt            Software licence.

QUICK START — WINDOWS
---------------------
  1. Insert the disc.
  2. If AutoPlay prompts you, choose
        "Open DICOM study with DICOM Viewer".
     Otherwise open the disc and double-click  dicom-viewer.exe.
  3. The viewer launches and loads the DICOM\ folder automatically.

QUICK START — macOS
-------------------
  1. Insert the disc; a "DICOM_VIEWER" drive icon appears.
  2. Open it and double-click  dicom-viewer  (or
     "Run viewer.command" if present).
  3. The viewer launches and loads the DICOM/ folder automatically.

QUICK START — LINUX
-------------------
  1. Insert / mount the disc.
  2. From a terminal in the mount point:
        ./dicom-viewer
     The viewer auto-loads the DICOM/ folder beside the binary.

LOADING A DIFFERENT FOLDER
--------------------------
  Drag a folder of .dcm files onto the running viewer window,
  or use  File ▸ Open Folder…

DATA STAYS WITH YOU
-------------------
  The viewer never modifies the DICOM files on this disc.
  Annotations and settings save to your user profile (Windows:
  %APPDATA%\dicom-viewer ; macOS: ~/Library/Application Support
  /dicom-viewer ; Linux: ~/.local/share/dicom-viewer).

THIS DISC IS NOT A MEDICAL DEVICE
---------------------------------
  The viewer is provided for review and reference only. It must
  not be used as the basis for a primary clinical diagnosis.
